## Summary

I implemented stylesheet link emission for CSS imported through JavaScript when an HTML file is used as a webpack entry point with both `experiments.html` and `experiments.css` enabled.

### The problem
When an HTML entry point contained `<script src="./entry.js">` and `entry.js` imported CSS (`import "./style.css"`), webpack emitted the `.css` chunk to the output directory but **never added a `<link rel="stylesheet">` tag** to the extracted HTML — so the styles never loaded in the browser.

### The fix
All changes are in **`lib/dependencies/HtmlScriptSrcDependency.js`** (plus a changeset). The `HtmlScriptSrcDependency` template already rewrote the script `src` in place and cloned sibling script tags for runtime/vendor chunks. I extended it to:

1. **`buildStylesheetLinkTag(originalTag, href)`** helper — constructs a `<link rel="stylesheet" href="…">` tag, copying only the security/fetch attributes (`nonce`, `crossorigin`, `referrerpolicy`) from the originating `<script>` tag, and deliberately excluding script-specific attributes (`defer`, `async`, `integrity`, `type`, `src`).

2. **`apply()`** — for script entries (`script-classic`/`script-module`), it now iterates the entrypoint's chunks in load order and, for each chunk with CSS (`CssModulesPlugin.chunkHasCss`), emits a link using the same filename template CSS uses to emit the file (so hrefs always match emitted assets). Links are joined **before** the sibling script tags and inserted at the tag position, so ordering is: authored links → auto-generated CSS links → runtime script → vendor script → entry script.

### Requirements coverage (all verified via a scratch build)
- One `<link>` per CSS chunk, in dependency/import order ✓
- Only `nonce`/`crossorigin`/`referrerpolicy` copied; `defer`/`async`/`integrity` not ✓
- Original script tag keeps all attributes, only `src` rewritten ✓
- All stylesheet links precede all script tags ✓
- Authored links first, then JS-bundle CSS links, then scripts ✓
- `@import` inside JS-imported CSS bundled into the same chunk, no extra link ✓
- runtimeChunk + splitChunks → runtime, vendor, entry order with links preceding ✓
- Every href/src corresponds to an emitted file ✓
